recipe.title: Pan-Seared Crispy Chicken Thigh with Garlic-Herb Rice
recipe.description: A refined, single-serve skillet dish featuring crisp-skinned chicken cooked directly over aromatic garlic and herb-infused jasmine rice.

instructions.text: Pat chicken thigh completely dry with paper towels and season generously with kosher salt, black pepper, and fresh thyme.
Heat olive oil in a small heavy-bottomed skillet over medium-high heat. Place chicken skin-side down and sear undisturbed for 6-8 minutes until deeply golden and crisp.
Flip chicken thigh, sear for 2 additional minutes, then temporarily transfer to a plate.
Reduce heat to medium, add minced garlic to the rendering fat, and sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add rinsed rice and stir for 1-2 minutes to toast the grains.
Pour in chicken broth, scrape up crispy browned bits from the pan bottom, and bring to a simmer. Nestle chicken thigh back on top, skin-side up.
Cover tightly with a lid, reduce heat to low, and simmer undisturbed for 15 minutes until rice is tender and chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Remove from heat and let stand covered for 5 minutes. Gently fold butter, fresh parsley, and lemon zest into the rice around the chicken before serving.

tips: Drying the chicken skin thoroughly before searing is essential for achieving ultra-crispy skin.
Rinsing the jasmine rice removes excess surface starch, ensuring fluffy, separate grains.
